#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>

using namespace std;

int main() {
  ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
  cin.tie(NULL);

  int n;
  string s;
  cin >> n >> s;
  vector<int> beauty(n);
  int totalBeauty = 0;
  for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
    cin >> beauty[i];
    totalBeauty += beauty[i];
  }

  vector<int> equalPairs;
  equalPairs.reserve(n / 2);
  int charOccurrencesInEqualPairs[128] = {0};
  char mostCommonCharInEqualPairs = 'a';

  for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; ++i) {
    if (s[i] == s[n - 1 - i]) {
      equalPairs.push_back(i);
      if (++charOccurrencesInEqualPairs[(int)s[i]] > charOccurrencesInEqualPairs[(int)mostCommonCharInEqualPairs]) {
        mostCommonCharInEqualPairs = s[i];
      }
    }
  }

  int ans = totalBeauty;
  for (int idx : equalPairs) {
    ans -= min(beauty[idx], beauty[n - 1 - idx]);
  }

  if (charOccurrencesInEqualPairs[(int)mostCommonCharInEqualPairs] > (int)equalPairs.size() / 2) {
    vector<int> nonEqualPairsMinBeautyPenalties;
    nonEqualPairsMinBeautyPenalties.reserve(n / 2);
    for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; ++i) {
      if (s[i] != s[n - 1 - i] && s[i] != mostCommonCharInEqualPairs && s[n - 1 - i] != mostCommonCharInEqualPairs) {
        nonEqualPairsMinBeautyPenalties.push_back(min(beauty[i], beauty[n - 1 - i]));
      }
    }
    sort(nonEqualPairsMinBeautyPenalties.begin(), nonEqualPairsMinBeautyPenalties.end());
    int rem = 2 * charOccurrencesInEqualPairs[(int)mostCommonCharInEqualPairs] - (int)equalPairs.size();
    for (int i = 0; i < rem; ++i) {
      ans -= nonEqualPairsMinBeautyPenalties[i];
    }
  }

  cout << ans << endl;
  return 0;
}
